panels.title: Tokens per issue, by role
panels.description: Tokens in millions per issue of the stage, in execution order, one segment per role. Issues not started yet are empty slots. The dashed grey line for the typical issue (median of the earlier stages of the project, needs three earlier stages) is not drawn: the built-in bar chart cannot take a threshold line from a query. The hidden query B holds the guarded median. The hover shows each segment and the total. The built-in bar chart has no total line, so the total is one more series "total" on its own hidden scale (its own max), with no fill, so it is not stacked on the segments, draws nothing and only shows in the hover (the value is the tokens in M, as the segments).

panels.title: Timeline
panels.description: One row for the orchestrator on top, then one row per issue in execution order. A block per launch in the role colour; a return keeps the role colour and its text starts with "↺". The hover shows the issue (the row), the role, the return number, the active time and the tokens of the launch (the sums of the launch in the time range of the board). The built-in state timeline has no custom hover, so the state is a number that holds these values; the step "Convert field type" makes it text (a regex value mapping matches only text), and a regex value mapping per role turns it into the text. The text is drawn on a block only when the block is wide enough. A return number above 9 shows as 9.

panels.title: Launches of this stage
panels.description: One row per launch of a subagent on an issue, newest first (the tokens of the orchestrator are in the bar charts, not here). A teal dot before the role marks a running launch. The marker columns show "▲" when the launch is above the 75th percentile of the same role in the other stages of the project (needs three earlier stages; the built-in table cannot colour a cell by a per-row threshold). Return is the attempt number minus one.
